messages:
maria: Heads up — console's quota attribution change landed in staging and it's causing the Go SDK to lose tenant attribution. Need a quick sync.

aj: When did that land?

maria: This morning, PR #4876. Console renamed the header to `x-redwood-route` (from `x-redwood-route-meta`) to simplify the shape. SDKs are still emitting the old header.

samir: Do we have a repro or logs? Is it the header name or the value shape?

maria: Quick log snippet: 
```
received headers: { "x-redwood-route": undefined }
sdk sent:   "x-redwood-route-meta": '{"quota_key":"team:foo","route_id":"r-123"}'
```

dina: Go SDK has a tight lookup for `RouteMeta` header only. Short-term mitigation: console can accept both headers and synthesize into the canonical field. That buys time.

tyler: @deploy-bot can we add a fallback copy in the staging ingest pipeline? e.g. copy `x-redwood-route-meta` -> `x-redwood-route` if new one missing.

deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging at 09:30 UTC. I'll run smoke tests. :gear: 

neha: This will affect telemetry & quota dashboards — we need to keep attribution continuity in metrics. Console team: please add mapping + a metric to track legacy header usage.

console-bot: Created CONS-912: "Accept legacy x-redwood-route-meta and map to x-redwood-route". Linked PR and dashboard task.

aj: SDK plan: ship patch that writes both headers for a transition window. Go and Py set both; TS do a minor that toggles opt-in before defaulting. Timeline?

samir: I can cut a Go patch today that sets both headers when present. I'll include a note: reads both, prefer new.

dina: Py patch tomorrow, TS minor next week. We should avoid breaking anyone who pins older SDKs — so server-side mapping is essential.

maria: Proposed rollout: 
1) Console accepts both headers (today/staging -> prod).
2) SDKs ship patches that write both headers (Go today, Py + TS within 7 days).
3) Console emits deprecation logs for legacy header and dashboard metric for legacy usage for 30 days.
4) After 60 days, console stops accepting legacy header.

Add a short migration note to the changelog and the SDK release notes.

dina: Also add telemetry labels while migrating: tag events as `route.v1` (new) and `route.v0` (legacy) so we can verify consistency.

neha: I'll update the quota dashboard with a new tile: `ingest.legacy_route_header_count` and a ratio `legacy/(legacy+new)`.

tyler: +1. Can we also surface a console alert if legacy ratio > 10% after 14 days?

console-bot: Alert rule added: `legacy_route_ratio > 0.1 for 14d` -> paging to #incidents.

maria: Perfect — I'll open an announcement to integrators and ping SDK consumers in #platform-integrations once the first SDK patches are published.

aj: I'll post Go PR link when ready.

samir: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/go-sdk/pull/789 — sets both headers, reads both, prefers `x-redwood-route`. Tests added.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the migration checklist and timeline in #eng-platform.

neha: One last note — add a console-side telemetry mapping test to our e2e to prevent regressions.

maria: Good call. Adding that to CONS-912.
